oil.when: 2009–2011 with the message center (Oil Minder) and RESET control
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Bring up the oil life display in the message center (OIL LIFE XXX%).
Press and hold RESET for about two seconds and let go. The display shows OIL LIFE XXX% HOLD RESET IF NEW OIL.
Press and hold RESET for about three seconds and let go. The display confirms the oil life start value, and oil life is back to 100%.
oil.note: The ENGINE OIL CHANGE SOON message appears at 10% oil life or less, and OIL CHANGE REQUIRED at 0%. Which message center button brings up the oil life display can vary; the owner's guide for your year shows it.

notes: The Grand Marquis is a twin of the Ford Crown Victoria.
